name: loopprism
description: See what your coding agents did: a skill and MCP tools to review a session's cost, context, loops and errors, spend across agents and ways to spend less; plus live runs for the LoopPrism app.

interface.shortDescription: See what your agents cost and did
interface.longDescription: Review a session's cost, context window, loops and errors, compare spend across coding agents, and find ways to spend less. Reads the session files already on your machine; nothing is sent anywhere. Hooks also stream live runs to the LoopPrism app.
defaultPrompt: Review this session: what did it cost and where did the tokens go?
What did my coding agents cost this week?
Find ways to spend less on my agent sessions.
